Merge survey with CPI

add_cpi.Rd

Accepts either a named numeric vector (format produced by pd_aux_attr()) or a data.table (legacy format from pipload::pip_load_aux("cpi")).

Usage

add_cpi(dt, cpi)

Arguments

dt

A cleaned survey data.table with a cpi_data_level column.

cpi

Named numeric vector or data.table.

Value

dt augmented with one cpiYYYY column per base year and a cpi_years attribute listing the year strings.

Details

Named vector names follow the pattern {cpi_year}_{reporting_level}, e.g. "2017_national". Each unique year becomes a cpiYYYY column in dt with the matching value looked up via cpi_data_level.
